name: Mirissa Beach and the Main Bay
tagline: The palm-fringed heart of the action
description: The crescent main bay is Mirissa's center of gravity: golden sand, swimmable water in season, beach bars, seafood restaurants, and most of the guesthouses. It is lively, social, and walkable, with everything a slow-travel nomad needs steps from the sand, though it grows crowded and pricier in high season.
bestFor: Beach lovers who want everything walkable and sociable
pros: Right on the best swimming beach
Walkable to food, bars, and tours
cons: Crowded and noisy in high season

name: Coconut Tree Hill and the Eastern Headland
description: The eastern headland rising above the bay holds Mirissa's postcard viewpoint, Coconut Tree Hill, plus Parrot Rock nearby. Accommodation here sits slightly above and back from the main strip, trading a few minutes' walk for calmer surroundings, sunset views, and a more peaceful base while staying close to the beach.
bestFor: Travellers wanting views and quiet near the action
pros: Quieter than the main beach strip
cons: A short uphill walk to the sand

name: Mirissa Harbour Area
tagline: Where the whale boats set off
description: At the western end of town, the fishing harbour is the departure point for the famous blue-whale and dolphin watching boats. It is more working port than resort, with a gritty local character, but staying nearby means an easy early start for tours and a look at Sri Lanka's fishing life alongside the tourism.
bestFor: Whale-watchers wanting the earliest boat starts
pros: Closest to whale and dolphin tour departures
cons: Less pretty than the main beach

name: Weligama
description: A short hop west along the coast, Weligama is a wide, gently curving bay famous as Sri Lanka's beginner surf spot, with surf schools, board rental, and a larger long-stay traveller and nomad crowd. It offers more cafes and a mellower, spread-out feel than Mirissa, making an easy alternative base close by.
bestFor: Beginner surfers and longer-stay remote workers
pros: Ideal gentle waves for learning to surf
cons: Less compact and lively than Mirissa
